coaching.headline: Conversion decided the game: five of six won fights cashed into prizes, and the allied side took three Fangtooths, Genesis Core and Orb Prime.

flags.text: Khaimera was the damn engine: 15 kills, and the most hero and objective damage of all ten players.
Sparrow scored the game's last three kills, then razed the enemy duo inhibitor before the Core fell.
Valmont died nine times, four to Phase; deaths within a minute before enemy Mini Prime and Primal Fangtooth.
Kwang owned the shit out of the offlane, killing Grux six times, then destroying the allied offlane inner.

focus.title: Convert every win, shelter losing lanes
focus.action: Keep turning every won fight into a structure or objective. Once a laner has died twice to the same opponent, the laner farms under tower until Khaimera arrives for a gank.

25.call: Lost 0-2 on mid as Phase killed Valmont and Steel; after enemy Primal Fangtooth, the allied side took the enemy offlane inner. When the pit is lost, answer with a tower again.

11.5.call: Lost 1-5 across the offlane and mid: Kwang killed Grux twice on the offlane, the allied offlane outer fell, and Scarlett and Phase scored three mid kills. After an early offlane death, mid and support skip the next mid fight.

14.3.call: Won 4-1 around the Fangtooth pit with allied Fangtooth and three Khaimera kills; Valmont died in the fight, then the allied mid outer fell. After a pit win, rotate a laner to mid.

19.4.call: Won 5-0 across two separate plays, with Sparrow and Khaimera scoring two kills each. Before Fangtooth spawns, look for picks on both sides of the map again.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Hero damage ran 1209 per minute on a 636 norm, with two kills at the Fangtooth pit around the second allied Fangtooth. When Fangtooth nears spawn, clear toward the pit.
All three deaths came in lost fights; in the fight lost 1-5, three allies fell first. With two allies down, skip the fight and take a camp or tower.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: A rotation kill on Legion at mid was followed by allied Fangtooth and the enemy offlane outer tower. When the duo lane is quiet, repeat the mid trip before Fangtooth.
One of three deaths came outside any detected fight, to Kwang in the enemy jungle. Before entering the enemy jungle, wait until Kwang shows on a lane.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Mitigated 48857 damage, the game's highest, and killed Kwang on the offlane before allied Fangtooth. When Fangtooth is next up, repeat the same offlane rotation.
Seven wards on an 11.7 norm while Dekker placed 28, with no wards cleared. Before each Fangtooth, use every ward the Rift Walkers cap allows on the pit entrances.
f4ffe152-43ff-4ce1-ae0f-d5a8f1110896: Farm held at 10.1 CS per minute on an 8.3 norm. Kwang's Magnify and Flux Matrix push magical damage; versus that build, finish Mistmeadow Buckler first.
Kill participation 6% of 33 team kills; hero damage 380 per minute on a 665 norm. Once the enemy offlane outer falls, join the next fight elsewhere.
e85d3db9-74ff-4c49-ba8a-5f8826b753fc: Three of four kills landed on Scarlett, two on the mid lane. When Scarlett shows at mid with Khaimera nearby, take the same trade again.
First blood went to Phase, and three more deaths came to Scarlett on the mid lane. When Scarlett is unseen, play mid from tower range until Khaimera finds Scarlett.

matchup: Phase died to Khaimera most often, six of the 15 Khaimera kills, despite healing on every ability cast.
Scarlett, the jungle opponent, killed Khaimera once and died to Khaimera once.
Scarlett's Tainted Blade cuts the target's healing on physical damage, trimming Draconum's takedown heal.
build: Overlord and Draconum match the winning core; Sky Splitter stands in for Rapture.
Sky Splitter adds current-health damage on basic attacks, while Rapture adds close-range on-hit damage and omnivamp.
Ashbringer, finished last, cuts non-ultimate cooldowns on basic attacks; earlier fights ran without Ashbringer.
eternal: Lotus grants a random damage, haste, speed or health bonus every two minutes and on every takedown.
Lotus leans first in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna is the best Lotus pair; the Early Bloom and Immaculate pair trails.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power by level in any jungle, more in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion is clearly the best Khaimera jungle augment in the field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits, weaker after the first hero.
Eviscerator is clearly the best Khaimera jungle crest; among well-played crests, Judgement trails Eviscerator, Pacifier, Ortus and Liberator.
improvement: Eviscerator over Judgement swaps Champion Crest for Sharpshooter Crest: active attack speed and omnivamp, giving up the area heal.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna: kill and hero damage, giving up a level and damage reduction, plus more damage taken.

matchup: Sparrow killed Dekker and Legion on the duo lane early; allied duo deaths before minute ten ran zero against two.
Dekker's Stasis Bomb stuns and Containment Fence blocks enemy heroes; Dekker scored the first Sparrow death.
build: Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra, the full winning core, are all missing.
Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on basic attacks, the anti-heal answer to Phase's cast healing.
Terminus, finished last, turns lifesteal overhealing into a shield; earlier fights ran without Terminus.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles on damaging a low-health hero; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after leaving Heightened Senses stealth.
Thraex leans first in the Sparrow carry field and Weald ranks second; Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair.
augment: Endless Hunt resets basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and adds permanent physical penetration.
Sun Shards leans ahead of Endless Hunt in the Sparrow carry field.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield, a cleanse for Dekker and Legion slows.
Pacifier is clearly the best Sparrow carry crest; Liberator ranks second among well-played crests.
improvement: Pacifier over Liberator stays on the Sharpshooter Crest path: a dash and an empowered physical hit, giving up the cleanse.
Sun Shards over Endless Hunt is the field lean: ricocheting basic attacks, giving up the takedown cooldown resets.

matchup: Dekker went 1/6/6 and scored none of the five Steel deaths; Khaimera and Sparrow killed Dekker six times.
Phase took three of five Steel deaths, two on the mid lane; Legion and Scarlett took the other two.
build: Xenia, Dynamo and Gaia Greaves, the full winning core, are all missing.
Tainted Charm cuts healing and slows enemy heroes nearby, steady anti-heal against Phase without needing a hit.
Vainglory, finished last, stacks armor while dealing or taking hero damage; earlier fights ran without Vainglory.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health by level; Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns.
Knell, Pilow and Idrisil lead a toss-up in the Steel support field; Krix, the most played, ranks below all three.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair.
augment: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to heavy punches and Shield Bash, scaled from total armors.
Colossal Crash, Heavy Metal and Adaptive Force are a toss-up in the Steel support field. Sound keep.
crest: Rift Walkers' active dashes forward and pulls nearby heroes; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Leafsong leans first in the Steel support field; Rift Walkers trails Leafsong and Sanctification.
improvement: Leafsong over Rift Walkers stays on the Warden Crest path: team speed and slow immunity, giving up the pull.
Idrisil, the most played toss-up contender, offers armor and a low-health shield instead of Krix's scaling health.

matchup: Kwang's 37535 hero damage was the enemy high, and none of Kwang's three deaths went to Grux.
Kwang's Judgement of the Heavens tethers, and Surge of the Heavens knocks up and stuns on dashing into the blade.
Kwang's Magnify shreds magical armor on ability hits and Flux Matrix cuts nearby enemy tenacity.
build: Sky Splitter, Basilisk and Salvation, the full winning core, are all missing.
Mistmeadow Buckler blocks magical damage with charges, and Unbroken Will raises both armors when immobilized.
Augmentation, finished last, empowers the next basic attack after an ability cast; earlier fights ran without Augmentation.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage against, and less damage from, the marked hero.
Knell leans first in the Grux offlane field over Thraex; Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the best Thraex pair.
augment: Red Mist adds attack speed per nearby enemy hero or camp leader carrying Bloodlust.
Red Mist leads a toss-up with Chieftain's Blink in the Grux offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Iceskorn Talons' active lays an ice sheet: allies on the sheet gain physical power and speed, enemies are slowed.
Gravitum, Eviscerator and Saphir's Mantle lead a toss-up in the Grux offlane field; Iceskorn Talons, the most played, trails all three.
improvement: Gravitum over Iceskorn Talons stays on the Champion Crest path: an infinite-range grounding projectile instead of the ice sheet.
Knell over Thraex is the field lean: armor shred stacks on hits, giving up the single-target mark.

matchup: Phase out-earned Valmont 16834 gold to 14595 and finished 9/8/3 on the mid lane.
Phase's Essence Catalyst heals on each ability cast, so anti-heal fits the mid matchup.
build: Entropy matches the winning core; Prophecy and Dreambinder stand in for Azure Core and Overseer.
Prophecy adds magical on-hit damage to basic attacks; Dreambinder slows on ability damage.
Tainted Scepter, finished last, cuts healing on magical damage; earlier fights ran without Tainted Scepter.
eternal: Vesh adds a damage-over-time echo of ability damage on heroes; Lich grants magical lifesteal growing by level.
Aion, Demiurge and Vesh are a toss-up in the Valmont mid field. Sound keep.
Lich with Phylactery is the best Vesh pair; Lich with Mind Rot, the most played, trails.
augment: Vein Splitter removes the Arterial Grip ground but branches the bind to nearby enemies with the full slow.
Sanguine Banquet is clearly the best Valmont mid augment; Vein Splitter has too few games to lead.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Typhoon, Soulbearer and Epoch are a toss-up in the Valmont mid field. Sound keep.
improvement: Sanguine Banquet over Vein Splitter is the field-backed swap: omnivamp and mana growth, giving up the branching bind.
Phylactery over Mind Rot matches the best Vesh pair: cooldown progression and a shield after the ultimate.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Phase. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
enemyKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
enemyKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
enemyKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
enemyKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

kwang.loadout: Xyris (Furor + Cull the Weak), augment Slayer of the Heavens, crest Tempest
fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,173 hero damage a minute, more than 85% of Kwang offlane players this patch (30% of the team's). The damage came from Tainted Scepter, Oathkeeper, Flux Matrix.
Fury of the Heavens at rank 3: 85s base, about 47.8s by the end (44% shorter) from 78 ability haste: Tainted Scepter 10, Magnify 15, Oathkeeper 15, Flux Matrix 15, Golem's Gift 15, Tempest 8.
15 takedowns (10 kills, 5 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Kwang dealt 37,535 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +320 magical power from items.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Oathkeeper (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 65 (+35%) Damage On-Hit.
Flux Matrix (item): Nearby Enemy Heroes: Take 10% additional Magical Damage. Have their Tenacity decreased by 50%.
Tempest (crest): Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
Cull the Weak (Eternal minor): Deal 7% bonus damage to Minions and Monsters, and restore 1% Missing Mana on unit kill.
Slayer of the Heavens (augment): Strike of the Heavens deals 25% more damage and reduces Cooldowns by 25% more.

Sustain: 8% omnivamp; Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; Tempest: Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.; 3,767 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1075 health, +40 physical armor, +45 magical armor; took 42,703 damage, mitigated 48,321, died 3 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Magnify, Tempest.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Kwang killed built magical armor (Grux, Khaimera). Anti-heal on Sparrow, Steel, Valmont. We killed Kwang 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Kwang offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Fury of the Heavens came back about every 48s instead of 85s by the end (44% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 696 damage mitigated a minute, more than 90% of Phase mid players this patch.

Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Ranged Basic Attack: Fire 2 additional projectiles. Each deals 10-35% (increases with Range) () Damage. Can Critically Strike and apply Lifesteal.

Obelisk (crest): Enhanced Basic Attack. Deal 50 (+15%) Damage. If the Target dies within 3s, collect a Soul. Damage increases by 6 for each Soul collected.
Demiurge (Eternal): Increase stats gained from Items (excluding passives) by 10%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.

Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Onixian Quiver.
Countered? 3 of the 4 players Phase killed built magical armor (Steel, Grux, Khaimera). Anti-heal on Sparrow, Steel, Valmont. We killed Phase 8 times.
Copy it? Too few Phase midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

khaimera.loadout: Lotus (Early Bloom + Immaculate), augment Jungle Invasion, crest Judgement

sources.note: random: 39 procs, 1 in 4 is +4 haste (expected value)
sources.how: 39 random bonuses (every 2 min and every takedown), 1 in 4 is +4 haste: about +39 expected

fedBy: Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
ultPlus: Ashbringer (Chrono Strikes): On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.• Only triggers once per ability.• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.
lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 70% of the team's kills (more than 91% of Khaimera jungle players this patch) and died 3 times (fewer than about 78% of them). Lotus turned 23 takedowns into ability haste, so Cull came back every ~35s instead of 60s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Khaimera touched shortened Cull, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 34.5s late); fight right after Cull is spent.
Cull at rank 3: 60s base, about 34.5s by the end (43% shorter) from 74 ability haste: Draconum 15, Void Helm 10, Ashbringer 10, Lotus 39.
23 takedowns (15 kills, 8 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow), Lotus (Eternal).

Ashbringer (Chrono Strikes): On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.• Only triggers once per ability.• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Khaimera dealt 38,703 hero damage, 31% of their team's, with +167 physical power from items.
Overlord (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Deal (+1%) Damage. Deal (+30%) (+2.5%) Damage around the Target. Damage decreases from 100% to 50% based on distance.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Immaculate (Eternal minor): Gain 10% Damage Reduction above 85% current health.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; 4% omnivamp; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Void Helm: Heal 20% more from all sources.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; 13,298 healing recorded.
Toughness: +775 health, +40 physical armor, +45 magical armor; took 53,388 damage, mitigated 38,177, died 3 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Draconum, Void Helm, Judgement.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Overlord, Sky Splitter, Ashbringer.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Draconum, Lotus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Early Bloom + Immaculate) sits on the same trigger as the items (every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Khaimera killed built physical armor (Dekker, Kwang). Anti-heal on Phase, Scarlett, Kwang, Legion. We killed Khaimera 3 times.

Copy it? Lotus (Early Bloom + Immaculate): 58.2% in 153 Khaimera jungle games, above the hero's 51.7%; this 3-item core: 65.1% in 63 games, above the 56.8% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Khaimera's takedowns fed Cull: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Cull is used.
